Expected values (expected_jpg_count=4, expected_png_count=1) correctly reflect the 4 .jpg files and 1 .png file present in the setup.
Both instruction requirements (jpgs to cpjpg AND pngs to cppng) are independently verified with 0.5 partial credit each.
Negative control resistance is good: initial state has empty cpjpg and no cppng, yielding score=0.0; successful completion yields score=1.0.
